description: Reasoning Schemas & Problem-Solving Archetypes for Whole Numbers, Arithmetic Operations, Prime Factorization, GCD/LCM, and Divisibility Rules.

archetypes.name: Place Value Expanded Partition (การกระจายค่าประจำหลัก)
archetypes.coreConcept: Decomposing numbers into base-10 positional components where each digit value is weighted by its power of 10.
mentalModel: 1. Identify the positional column of each digit.
2. Multiply digit by positional weight (units, tens, hundreds, thousands).
3. Sum weighted components to reconstruct the integer.

cognitiveTraps.description: Misinterpreting zero in intermediate position, compressing positional weight.

versatileDomains.description: Counting currency banknotes by denomination.
Counting bulk pallets, boxes, and individual items.

archetypes.name: Positional Rounding & Halfway Boundary (การปัดเศษตามค่าประจำหลัก)
archetypes.coreConcept: Replacing a number with an approximate value to a given place value based on the test digit (>= 5 rounds up, < 5 rounds down).
mentalModel: 1. Locate the rounding target place value digit.
2. Inspect the decisive digit immediately to the right.
3. If digit >= 5 add 1 to target place and zero out remaining; else preserve target and zero out remaining.

cognitiveTraps.description: Always rounding down or truncating without inspecting the decisive next digit.

versatileDomains.description: Rounding procurement expenses to nearest thousand.
Estimating running trail distances.

archetypes.name: Quotient & Remainder Division Partitioning (การหารจำนวนเต็มและเศษ)
archetypes.coreConcept: The division algorithm partitions a dividend into a whole number quotient of equal divisor packets plus an integer remainder strictly less than the divisor.
mentalModel: 1. Determine maximum integer quotient q such that q * divisor <= dividend.
2. Subtract q * divisor from dividend to calculate integer remainder r.
3. Verify that 0 <= r < divisor.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting divisor from dividend once rather than dividing across all packets.

versatileDomains.description: Packing manufactured goods into shipping boxes.
Distributing client tasks across worker nodes.

archetypes.name: Canonical Prime Factorization (การแยกตัวประกอบเฉพาะ)
archetypes.coreConcept: Every integer greater than 1 has a unique decomposition into a product of prime powers.
mentalModel: 1. Test divisibility by ascending primes (2, 3, 5, 7...).
2. Extract prime factors repeatedly until reaching 1.
3. Count exponents of distinct prime factors.

cognitiveTraps.description: Stopping at a composite factor instead of factoring completely to primes.

versatileDomains.description: Factoring composite modulus components.
Matching prime teeth numbers for uniform wear.

archetypes.name: Conjoint Composite Divisibility Testing (เกณฑ์การหารลงตัวของจำนวนประกอบ)
archetypes.coreConcept: A number is divisible by a composite modulus m = a * b (where gcd(a, b) = 1) if and only if it is divisible by both a and b.
mentalModel: 1. Factor composite divisor into coprime components (e.g. 15 = 3 * 5).
2. Test divisibility by each coprime factor using terminal digit and digit sum rules.
3. If all coprime tests pass, the number is divisible by the composite modulus.
archetypes.governingRelation: m | N <=> (a | N) and (b | N) where gcd(a, b) = 1

cognitiveTraps.description: Incorrectly applying the sum-of-digits rule to divisors other than 3 or 9.

versatileDomains.description: Grouping production runs into batches of 6, 12, or 15.
Verifying memory word alignment.

archetypes.name: Greatest Common Divisor via Euclidean Reduction (ห.ร.ม. และขั้นตอนวิธีแบบยุคลิด)
archetypes.coreConcept: The greatest common divisor of two integers is the largest integer dividing both, invariant under Euclidean subtraction: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a mod b). L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Assuming the difference (a - b) is always the GCD without factoring (tag `c01-gcd-difference-underestimate`)'; the prompt shows the work as 'Line N: $...$' lines and the learner picks the first wrong line (answerSpec `choice` with `verify.flaw`; asking for the corrected value lets the learner just recompute, 06 §2.3).
mentalModel: 1. Set larger number as dividend and smaller as divisor.
2. Compute remainder.
3. Replace dividend with divisor and divisor with remainder until remainder is 0; last non-zero remainder is GCD.
archetypes.governingRelation: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a mod b)

cognitiveTraps.description: Assuming the difference (a - b) is always the GCD without factoring.

versatileDomains.description: Determining largest square tile side length to cover floor without cuts.
Cutting ribbons of equal max length without waste.

archetypes.name: Least Common Multiple Periodic Coincidence (ค.ร.น. และจุดบรรจบของรอบเวลา)
archetypes.coreConcept: The least common multiple of two positive integers is the smallest positive integer divisible by both, governing periodic simultaneous occurrences.
mentalModel: 1. Find prime factorization of both cycle periods.
2. Take maximum power for each prime.
3. Compute product to determine first simultaneous coincidence timestamp.

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying the two numbers directly without dividing by common factors.

versatileDomains.description: Finding when two bus lines depart terminal together.
Calculating orbital conjunction recurrence intervals.

archetypes.name: Hierarchical Order of Operations (ลำดับการคำนวณขั้นสูง)
archetypes.coreConcept: Mathematical expressions evaluate deterministically according to precedence: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication & Division (left to right), Addition & Subtraction (left to right).
mentalModel: 1. Simplify expressions inside innermost grouping brackets.
2. Evaluate exponential powers.
3. Perform multiplication and division from left to right.
4. Perform addition and subtraction from left to right.

cognitiveTraps.description: Performing addition/subtraction before multiplication/division due to reading left to right.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating composite structural loads from grouped component terms.
Computing net pay after tiered bonus multipliers and deductions.

archetypes.name: GCD-LCM Pair Reconstruction (การหาคู่จำนวนจาก ห.ร.ม. และ ค.ร.น.)
archetypes.coreConcept: Given only gcd g and lcm L of two unknown numbers (plus one extra condition such as their sum, difference or a bound), reconstruct the pair: write a = g*m and b = g*n with gcd(m, n) = 1, split L / g into coprime factor pairs (m, n), then use the extra condition to select the pair.
mentalModel: 1. Write a = g * m and b = g * n where gcd(m, n) = 1.
2. Use gcd * lcm = a * b to get m * n = L / g.
3. Prime-factorize L / g and list every split into coprime factors m, n.
4. Apply the extra condition (sum, difference or bound) to select the pair (a, b).
archetypes.governingRelation: a = g m,\ b = g n,\ \gcd(m, n) = 1,\ m n = \frac{L}{g}

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding gcd and lcm instead of multiplying them before dividing.
Accepting a factor split of L / g whose parts share a common factor, which gives a pair whose gcd is larger than g.

versatileDomains.description: Computing network synchronization intervals between clock domains.
Harmonizing frequency modulation bandwidths.

archetypes.name: Constrained Multi-Packet Remainder Optimization (การจัดชุดแบบมีเงื่อนไขเศษตกค้าง)
archetypes.coreConcept: Finding a quantity satisfying simultaneous modular packing constraints across multiple pack sizes with fixed non-zero remainders.
mentalModel: 1. Express target quantity as a system of congruences: N = q1 * m1 + r1 = q2 * m2 + r2.
2. Identify structural offsets or common remainder differences (N + c is divisible by both m1 and m2).
3. Apply lcm(m1, m2) and subtract offset to find minimal positive solution.

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying packaging sizes and adding both remainders directly.

versatileDomains.description: Optimizing pill packaging into blister cards and bulk cartons.
Sizing data buffers across variable-length transmission windows.
